doc: Monster script rin for Lin (kind 602, model lin_boss), placed with Gaspard and the Evil Flame for the Gaspard boss fight at the Lighthouse on the Cape (d03b02). Lin cannot be locked on to or damaged; it cowers, looks around and is startled when a monster comes within 100 units, and when one comes within 6 units it runs map program 520, the boss-defeat game over.
